import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*T**4+p[4]*L+p[5]*L*T**2+p[6]*L/T
            +p[7]/eps+p[8]*T**2/eps+p[9]*np.exp(-eps)*T**2)
